newsitem.title: USA: Arvin sees gain from Argentine unit sale.
newsitem.headline: Arvin sees gain from Argentine unit sale.

text.p: Arvin Industries Inc said Friday it expects a pretax gain of about $11 million from the sale of its 31.4 percent equity interest in its Argentine affiliate, Fric-Rot S.A.I.C. to Tenneco Corp.
It sold the stake for about $17.0 million.
Earlier, Tenneco Automotive, a unit of Tenneco, said it acquired about 94 percent of Fric-Rot, a ride control manufacturer. Tenneco bought the stake for $52 million.
Arvin said that, initially, proceeds from the sale will be used to reduce short-term debt.

"We have decided to take advantage of the opportunity to sell our share of Fric-Rot, so we can approach the Mercosur market with greater flexibility and maximize our growth opportunities," Byron Pond, chairman, said in a statement.
The Mercosur market, which comprises Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay, is one of the fastest growing markets in the world, Arvin said.

"Although we have sold our share in Fric-Rot, we remain committed to serving our global customers and being a leading supplier of exhaust systems and ride control products for the Mercosur original equipment and replacement markets," Pond said. "We have significant business interests in several South American countries, and will be aggressively pursuing various options to further build on our position throughout the region."
He added that these options could include additional joint ventures, as well as investing in new facilities to manufacture ride control products
Pond also said the absence of an equity interest in Fric-Rot will be more than offset by the positive impact of implementing profit improvement projects that will start paying back next year.
